paragraphs: In the morning, they see sprains and strains in clinic and combine examinations with imaging to choose conservative care or surgery. In the afternoon, they perform arthroscopy. During competitions, they wait on the sideline and make the first assessment when a player goes down. After surgery, they coordinate plans with rehabilitation therapists and monitor the athlete's step-by-step return to competition.

It combines cognitive and hands-on work and safeguards athletes' health.
